_notes: Creatures that are not humanoids (2026-11-14): no T-pose, no rigger. The giant black widow's body only: its legs are made and walked procedurally in Unity (SpiderLegs), so the generated model must have no legs.
common: Isolated on a plain light grey background, the whole thing visible and centred. Dark realistic Nordic folk-tale style, not cute. Matte, softly lit, no glow, no shadows on the ground.

looks.prompt: The body of a giant black widow spider with every leg removed, like a museum specimen without its legs: seen from the side and slightly above. A huge glossy jet-black round abdomen with a vivid red hourglass mark on its underside and a thin red stripe on top, joined by a narrow waist to a smaller black cephalothorax with eight small dark-red glinting eyes in two rows and two curved black fangs, fine short bristles, no legs at all.
